reason: The phone and wireless arcs are detached device-linking qualifiers rather than structural parts of the television.

components.name: Wide Television Frame
components.description: A wide television screen has a short central pedestal and flat foot. Exclude the phone and wireless arcs.

components.name: Upright Phone Frame
components.description: A rounded upright phone has a horizontal seam near its lower edge. Exclude the television and wireless arcs.

components.name: Wireless Arc Pair
components.description: Two small nested signal arcs sit above the source screen. Isolate these arcs; exclude all devices.
